plan.title: AD lesional vs control hallmark GSEA (Python)
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question asks only which hallmark pathways are enriched in the treated (atopic dermatitis lesional) versus control contrast, and the DESeq2 results table for that contrast is already delivered (/data/inputs/results/de_results.csv, 12000 genes x 8 columns, gene symbols). No new differential expression test is therefore fitted — refitting would be unasked scope and would risk producing a second, subtly different contrast. The plan has three steps. T1S1 is a sample-structure sanity check on the delivered Salmon count matrix (12000 genes x 12 samples, 6 treated vs 6 control) with blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes, a sample-distance heatmap, and per-sample library sizes; this exists specifically because the profile flags sample_01 at roughly 4x below median library size. Per R-0008 that sample is kept, inspected and reported, not silently dropped — the delivered DE results already include it, so dropping it here would decouple the QC from the enrichment input. T2S1 is the analysis that answers the question: preranked GSEA (gseapy, the Python implementation of the fgsea/GSEA preranked algorithm) over every tested gene ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic against the MSigDB human hallmark collection v2026.1 staged in the reference store (50 sets, HGNC symbols — matching the gene-symbol identifier space of the results table, so no Entrez remapping is required and identifier spaces are never mixed). The ranking metric is a disputed choice under R-0108: this plan chooses the Wald statistic, because it is signed and scaled by its own standard error and therefore does not give a low-count gene an inflated rank, unlike the unshrunken log2 fold change, and does not produce mass ties like a signed p-value. The full ranked list is used, never a thresholded one, with a 15-500 gene size window applied after intersecting each set with the tested genes. T1S3 assembles the report: significant hallmark sets at BH-adjusted p < 0.05 with NES, leading-edge genes per set, leading-edge overlap between reported sets (so redundant sets are read as one finding), the pinned collection version, the rank metric, the universe, the size window, the permutation seed, and package versions. Every script is Python, per the user constraint — pydeseq2 for the VST/QC and gseapy for the preranked test, both confirmed present in the sandbox. The direction convention must be stated explicitly in every output: a positive NES means enrichment among genes higher in treated (AD lesional) relative to control, which requires confirming the sign convention of log2_fold_change in the delivered table before interpretation.
